units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:1">Esth. R. to III, 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 33:7">Is. XXXIII, 7</cite>) <he>וכל צבא … בוכים במ׳</he> all the hosts on high weep bitterly.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5:1">Cant. R. to V, 5</cite> (play on <he>מור עבר</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5:1">ib.</cite>) <he>עבר על מְרָרִי</he> he passed over (pardoned) my sin.—Pl. <he>מְרָרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ דגזר כורש וכ׳</he> troubles,—when Cyrus decreed and said &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ שאמרתי לעגל וכ׳</he> sins,—when I said of the calf, these are thy gods &c.
